quests.instruction: Which small building beside the tracks controls the signals that guide passing trains?
quests.question: Signal Box
quests.hint: Think about the small building beside the railway where a worker controls signals to guide passing trains.
quests.explanation: A signal box is a building that controls train signals. Workers in a signal box help guide trains safely!
quests.funFact: Old signal boxes were filled with large levers a worker would pull to control the tracks!

quests.instruction: Which longer, prettier path is chosen for its beautiful views instead of speed?
quests.question: Scenic Route
quests.hint: Think about choosing a longer, winding road just because of its gorgeous mountain or ocean views.
quests.explanation: A scenic route is a path chosen for its beautiful views. Travelers pick a scenic route to enjoy the journey!
quests.funFact: Taking a scenic route can turn an ordinary drive into a truly memorable part of the trip!

quests.instruction: Which roadside camera automatically takes a photo of cars driving too fast?
quests.question: Speed Camera
quests.hint: Think about the camera mounted beside the road that snaps a photo if a car passes by too quickly.
quests.explanation: A speed camera photographs cars driving too fast. Speed cameras help remind drivers to follow the speed limit!
quests.funFact: A speed camera can measure a car's exact speed the instant it passes by!

quests.instruction: Which section of road is marked off with cones and signs while workers make repairs?
quests.question: Construction Zone
quests.hint: Think about the section of road lined with orange cones and signs, where workers are busy fixing the pavement.
quests.explanation: A construction zone is a road section marked for repairs. Drivers slow down carefully through a construction zone!
quests.funFact: Slowing down in a construction zone helps keep both drivers and road workers safe!

quests.instruction: Which sign directs drivers along a different path when the usual road is closed?
quests.question: Detour Sign
quests.hint: Think about the sign with an arrow pointing a different way, guiding drivers around a closed road.
quests.explanation: A detour sign directs drivers along a different path. Detour signs guide traffic around a closed road!
quests.funFact: Following detour signs one at a time helps drivers safely find their way, even on an unfamiliar road!

quests.instruction: Which triangular sign tells a driver to slow down and let other traffic go first?
quests.question: Yield Sign
quests.hint: Think about the red and white triangle sign that tells a driver to slow down and let others pass first.
quests.explanation: A yield sign tells drivers to let others go first. Yield signs are shaped like a red and white triangle!
quests.funFact: A yield sign's triangle shape helps drivers recognize it instantly, even from far away!

quests.instruction: Which sign shows that traffic on a street may only travel in a single direction?
quests.question: One-Way Sign
quests.hint: Think about the sign with a single arrow showing that cars on this street may only go one direction.
quests.explanation: A one-way sign shows traffic moves in only one direction. Drivers must never go the wrong way on a one-way street!
quests.funFact: One-way streets help traffic flow smoothly through crowded, narrow parts of a city!

quests.instruction: Which protective gear covers your head to keep it safe while riding a bicycle?
quests.question: Bike Helmet
quests.hint: Think about the hard, padded gear you strap onto your head before riding your bicycle.
quests.explanation: A bike helmet is protective gear for your head. Wearing a bike helmet helps keep every rider safer!
quests.funFact: A properly fitted bike helmet should sit snug and level, right above your eyebrows!

quests.instruction: Which bright vest helps a cyclist or worker be seen easily, even in low light?
quests.question: Reflective Vest
quests.hint: Think about the bright, shiny vest a road worker or nighttime cyclist wears to be seen easily.
quests.explanation: A reflective vest helps a person be seen easily. Reflective vests shine brightly when light hits them!
quests.funFact: A reflective vest bounces light straight back, making the wearer glow brightly in a car's headlights!

quests.instruction: Which bright orange cone marks off an area on the road to warn drivers away?
quests.question: Traffic Cone
quests.hint: Think about the tall, bright orange cone placed on the road to warn drivers to steer clear.
quests.explanation: A traffic cone is a bright orange marker on the road. Traffic cones warn drivers to stay away from an area!
quests.funFact: Traffic cones are bright orange because that color stands out clearly against almost any road!

quests.instruction: Which small machine on the sidewalk collects coins to pay for a parking spot?
quests.question: Parking Meter
quests.hint: Think about the small machine beside a parking spot where you feed in coins to pay for your time.
quests.explanation: A parking meter collects payment for a parking spot. Drivers feed coins into a parking meter to park legally!
quests.funFact: Many parking meters today also accept a card or a phone app instead of just coins!

quests.instruction: Which small device sticks to a windshield to pay tolls automatically without stopping?
quests.question: Toll Tag
quests.hint: Think about the small device on a windshield that lets a car pay a toll automatically, without even slowing down.
quests.explanation: A toll tag is a device that pays tolls automatically. Cars with a toll tag can drive through without stopping!
quests.funFact: A toll tag uses a wireless signal to pay a toll the instant a car drives past!

quests.instruction: Which camera shows a driver exactly what is behind their car while backing up?
quests.question: Rearview Camera
quests.hint: Think about the small camera on the back of a car that shows the view behind it right on a screen.
quests.explanation: A rearview camera shows the view behind a car. Rearview cameras help drivers back up safely!
quests.funFact: A rearview camera can help a driver spot something small, like a toy, behind the car before backing up!

quests.instruction: Which small extra mirror helps a driver see areas a regular mirror might miss?
quests.question: Blind Spot Mirror
quests.hint: Think about the small extra mirror attached to a car's side mirror, showing the tricky spot regular mirrors miss.
quests.explanation: A blind spot mirror shows areas a regular mirror misses. Blind spot mirrors help drivers change lanes safely!
quests.funFact: A blind spot mirror's curved shape lets it show a much wider view than a regular flat mirror!

quests.instruction: Which safety cushion instantly inflates to protect passengers during a sudden stop?
quests.question: Airbag
quests.hint: Think about the safety cushion hidden inside a steering wheel that inflates instantly to protect you.
quests.explanation: An airbag is a safety cushion that inflates instantly. Airbags help protect passengers during a sudden stop!
quests.funFact: An airbag can fully inflate in a tiny fraction of a second, faster than the blink of an eye!

quests.instruction: Which special seat keeps a young child safely buckled in a car?
quests.question: Child Car Seat
quests.hint: Think about the special seat with extra straps that keeps a young child safely buckled in the back seat.
quests.explanation: A child car seat keeps a young child safely buckled. Child car seats are designed just for smaller riders!
quests.funFact: A child car seat is specially designed and tested to help keep young children extra safe!

quests.instruction: Which raised seat helps an older child sit at the right height for a seatbelt to fit properly?
quests.question: Booster Seat
quests.hint: Think about the raised cushion that lifts an older child up just enough for their seatbelt to fit properly.
quests.explanation: A booster seat raises a child up for a proper seatbelt fit. Booster seats help older children ride safely!
quests.funFact: A booster seat helps make sure a seatbelt sits comfortably across a child's chest, not their neck!

quests.instruction: Which sturdy container attaches to the top of a car to carry extra luggage?
quests.question: Roof Box
quests.hint: Think about the sturdy, streamlined container attached to a car's roof, packed with extra bags for a trip.
quests.explanation: A roof box is a container on top of a car for extra luggage. Families use a roof box for a big road trip!
quests.funFact: A roof box gives a car much more room to pack for a long family vacation!

quests.instruction: Which small wheeled cart attaches behind a bicycle to carry a child or extra cargo?
quests.question: Bike Trailer
quests.hint: Think about the small cart attached behind a bicycle, carrying a young child safely along for the ride.
quests.explanation: A bike trailer is a cart attached behind a bicycle. Bike trailers carry children or extra cargo along a ride!
quests.funFact: A bike trailer lets a whole family enjoy a bike ride together, even the smallest riders!

quests.instruction: Which small extra wheels help a child balance while learning to ride a bicycle?
quests.question: Training Wheels
quests.hint: Think about the small extra wheels attached to a bicycle's back wheel, helping a child balance while learning.
quests.explanation: Training wheels are small extra wheels for balance. Training wheels help a child learn to ride a bicycle safely!
quests.funFact: Once a child feels confident balancing, the training wheels can finally be taken off!

quests.instruction: Which small ringing device on a bicycle warns others that you are coming through?
quests.question: Bike Bell
quests.hint: Think about the small bell on a bicycle's handlebar that a rider rings to warn walkers they are coming through.
quests.explanation: A bike bell is a small ringing device on a bicycle. Riders ring a bike bell to warn others they are near!
quests.funFact: A friendly ring from a bike bell is a polite way to let a walker know a cyclist is passing by!

quests.instruction: Which small tool pushes air into a bicycle tire that has gone flat or soft?
quests.question: Bike Pump
quests.hint: Think about the small tool you pump by hand to fill a soft bicycle tire back up with air.
quests.explanation: A bike pump pushes air into a bicycle tire. A bike pump helps fix a soft or flat tire!
quests.funFact: Keeping a bicycle tire filled with the right amount of air makes for a much smoother ride!

quests.instruction: Which place uses big brushes and soapy water to clean the outside of a car?
quests.question: Car Wash
quests.hint: Think about the place with big spinning brushes and soapy water that leaves a car sparkling clean.
quests.explanation: A car wash is a place that cleans the outside of a car. Cars drive through a car wash to get sparkling clean!
quests.funFact: Some car washes use giant spinning brushes, while others use only soft, gentle jets of water!

quests.instruction: Which service lets a driver order and pick up food without ever leaving their car?
quests.question: Drive-Through
quests.hint: Think about ordering a meal at a window and picking it up without ever stepping out of your car.
quests.explanation: A drive-through lets drivers get food from their car. Drivers order and pick up a meal at a drive-through window!
quests.funFact: A drive-through is a quick and convenient way to grab a meal on a busy road trip!

quests.instruction: Which machine at a gas station fills a car's tank with gasoline?
quests.question: Fuel Pump
quests.hint: Think about the tall machine at a gas station with a hose you use to fill your car's tank.
quests.explanation: A fuel pump fills a car's tank with gasoline. Drivers use a fuel pump at every gas station!
quests.funFact: A fuel pump can fill an entire car's tank in just a few short minutes!

quests.instruction: Which loud sound warns everyone nearby if someone tries to break into a parked car?
quests.question: Car Alarm
quests.hint: Think about the loud, sudden sound a car makes if someone tries to open it without the right key.
quests.explanation: A car alarm is a loud sound warning of a break-in. Car alarms help protect a parked car from theft!
quests.funFact: A car alarm's loud sound is meant to quickly get the attention of everyone nearby!

quests.instruction: Which extra tire is kept in a car's trunk in case one goes flat?
quests.question: Spare Tire
quests.hint: Think about the extra tire tucked away in a car's trunk, ready to replace one that goes flat.
quests.explanation: A spare tire is an extra tire kept for emergencies. Drivers use a spare tire if one of their tires goes flat!
quests.funFact: Keeping a spare tire ready helps a driver get back on the road quickly after a flat tire!

quests.instruction: Which two long wires connect two car batteries to help start a car with a dead battery?
quests.question: Jumper Cables
quests.hint: Think about the two long, clipped wires connecting one car's battery to another to help start a dead one.
quests.explanation: Jumper cables are wires that connect two batteries. Jumper cables help start a car with a dead battery!
quests.funFact: Jumper cables safely share a little power from one car's battery to help start another one!

quests.instruction: Which helpful service sends someone to help a driver whose car has broken down?
quests.question: Roadside Assistance
quests.hint: Think about calling for help when your car breaks down, and a friendly worker arrives to fix it right there.
quests.explanation: Roadside assistance is a service that helps broken-down drivers. Roadside assistance sends help right to your car!
quests.funFact: Roadside assistance workers carry many tools so they can often fix a small problem right on the spot!

quests.instruction: Which small cover twists open to reveal a car's fuel tank opening?
quests.question: Gas Cap
quests.hint: Think about the small cover on the side of a car that you twist open before filling up with fuel.
quests.explanation: A gas cap is a cover for a car's fuel tank opening. Drivers twist off the gas cap before filling up!
quests.funFact: A gas cap seals tightly to help keep fuel safely inside the tank while driving!
